title: Geometry on principal curvature surfaces
summary: We study the geometry of the principal curvature surface associated with a Whitney umbrella. This surface is obtained by extending the Whitney umbrella in the normal direction by its bounded principal curvature and admits a natural geometric interpretation. We prove that its intersection with the normal plane coincides with the pedal curve of the curvature parabola and deduce that the focal conic is the inversion of this pedal curve.
